screen.no_room: Type a room, for example Küche

app.name: Scenes
app.summary: Scenes and lights as tiles on a gradient of their own colours.
app.colors_hint: Empty: the colours of the scene (from the Hue bridge) or of the light. Otherwise up to three colours as #RRGGBB, separated by commas: #3848FE, #FE6EBC.
app.room_hint: The scenes of this room appear on the screen as a grid (the editor does not show them). The rooms are named as in the Hue app.
app.scenes_hint: Empty: every scene of the room by name. Otherwise the names in your order, separated by commas: Kochen, Hell, Gedimmt, Miami.
